name: replicate-v1
purpose: Measure per-controller outcome variability and ranking reproducibility under the frozen pilot training conditions on Clutter. Diagnostic only: no selection, no reserved or transfer scenes, no optimizer update, no claim about adaptation.
approval: Sachin approved this diagnostic in session on 2026-10-18 after the frozen pilot was paused at a block boundary.

episode_runner: frozen experiments/scripts/maniguard_phase2_episode.py through the one-GPU worker shim; identical conditions to the pilot, including the deterministic per-scene policy seed; replicates differ only through renderer/physics nondeterminism

dispatch.rule: For each replicate round, a seeded permutation of the 24 controller/case cells; rounds are concatenated so every cell receives replicate k before any cell receives replicate k+2.

outcome_contract: frozen read_episode outcome (C_req, S_req, V, U) and costs; audit_episode_sources against the frozen pilot pins
analysis_plan: Per-controller safe-completion, completion and violation rates over 24 episodes with Wilson 95% intervals; per case as well.
Chi-square homogeneity test of safe completion across the eight controllers versus a single shared rate.

Spearman correlation between replicate safe-completion means and each of the two pilot single-episode round-0 fitness vectors (random/s17 and evolution/s17), and the agreement rate of those two pilot vectors with each other.
Required episodes per arm for 80% power to detect 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3 differences at the observed pooled base rate (two-sample binomial, one-sided alpha 0.05).
All results descriptive; no controller is selected or carried forward by this diagnostic.

resource_envelope.failure_rule: Count every attempted interaction. Zero-interaction setup failures may be voided under the standing rule (at most 2 per cell, 8 per deployment); any other failure is recorded and never retried.
resource_envelope.note: Separate from the frozen pilot envelope, which closes at the pilot pause. Instance rental accounting continues and is reported alongside.
